# Elliptic Integrals

![Elliptic Integrals function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/elliptic/00_Repertoire%20Elliptic%20Integrals.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Legendre elliptic integrals: Elliptic 1 and Elliptic 2. Select Complete/Incomplete manually; new nodes use Incomplete with a=pi/2. k_input=m is the squared modulus, never squared again.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Intégrales elliptiques**

Intégrales elliptiques de Legendre : Elliptic 1 et Elliptic 2. Choisir Complete/Incomplete manuellement ; nouvelle pose Incomplete avec a=pi/2. k_entrée=m est le carré du module, sans nouveau carré.

</details>

## Browse this palette

This entry opens a palette folder; it is not an executable dataflow function.

| Entry | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Elliptic 1 — Complete K](../../math/elliptic/first_kind/complete_k.md) | Complete elliptic integral of the first kind. k in [0,1]; K(1)=+Infinity with singularity. k=0.25 returns 1.685750354812596. Formula: K(m)=integral(0,pi/2,1/sqrt(1-m*sin(t)^2),dt). |
| [Elliptic 1](../../math/elliptic/first_kind/incomplete_f.md) | Incomplete elliptic integral of the first kind. k in [0,1]; signed finite a in radians, default pi/2. For m=1 require abs(a)&lt;pi/2; reaching or crossing a pole gives oriented Infinity and singularity. Explicit a=0 returns signed zero; periods accumulate. Formula: F(a\|m)=integral(0,a,1/sqrt(1-m*sin(t)^2),dt). |
| [Elliptic 2 — Complete E](../../math/elliptic/second_kind/complete_e.md) | Complete elliptic integral of the second kind. k in [0,1]; E(1)=1. k=0.25 returns 1.4674622093394272. Formula: E(m)=integral(0,pi/2,sqrt(1-m*sin(t)^2),dt). |
| [Elliptic 2](../../math/elliptic/second_kind/incomplete_e.md) | Incomplete elliptic integral of the second kind. k in [0,1]; every signed finite a in radians, default pi/2. E(a\|1) integrates abs(cos(t)), including beyond pi/2. Explicit a=0 returns signed zero; periods accumulate. Formula: E(a\|m)=integral(0,a,sqrt(1-m*sin(t)^2),dt). |
